mapper.select: SELECT t.req_id AS req_id, COALESCE(SUM(l.minutes), 0) AS actual_minutes FROM time_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND l.minutes IS NOT NULL AND t.req_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.req_id

SELECT l.user_id AS user_id, COALESCE(SUM(l.minutes), 0) AS actual_minutes FROM time_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.req_id = #{reqId} AND l.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND l.minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.user_id
SELECT MIN(completed_at) FROM task_completion_record WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT req_id AS req_id, MAX(completed_at) AS last_at FROM task_completion_record WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY req_id

SELECT x.req_id AS req_id, MAX(x.last_at) AS last_at FROM ( SELECT t.req_id AS req_id, t.updated_at AS last_at FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.req_id IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.req_id AS req_id, l.created_at AS last_at FROM task_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.req_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT t.req_id AS req_id, c.created_at AS last_at FROM task_comment c JOIN task t ON t.id = c.task_id AND t.workspace_id = c.workspace_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.req_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT d.req_id AS req_id, d.updated_at AS last_at FROM requirement_doc d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ) x GROUP BY x.req_id

SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(completed_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(completed_at) DAY) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM task_completion_record WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND completed_at >= #{from} AND completed_at < #{to} GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start

SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(created_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(created_at) DAY) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start
